parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "keyword": "{{ $('Extract Task Data').item.json.keyword }}",
  "task_id": "{{ $('Extract Task Data').item.json.task_id }}",
  "kunde": "{{ $('Extract Task Data').item.json.kunde }}",
  "doc_id": "{{ (() => { try { const n = $('Prepare Doc Info (New)').item.json.doc_id; return n || $('Extract Doc ID from ClickUp').item.json.doc_id; } catch(e) { return $('Extract Doc ID from ClickUp').item.json.doc_id; } })() }}",
  "doc_url": "{{ (() => { try { const n = $('Prepare Doc Info (New)').item.json.doc_url; return n || $('Extract Doc ID from ClickUp').item.json.doc_url; } catch(e) { return $('Extract Doc ID from ClickUp').item.json.doc_url; } })() }}",
  "outline_json": {{ JSON.stringify($json.outline_json) }},
  "wdf_idf_summary": {{ JSON.stringify($('WDF*IDF Calculator').item.json.wdf_idf_summary) }},
  "wdf_idf_terms": {{ JSON.stringify($('WDF*IDF Calculator').item.json.wdf_idf_terms) }},
  "perplexity_research": {{ JSON.stringify($('Perplexity Deep Research').item.json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '') }},
  "internal_linking_summary": {{ JSON.stringify($('Prepare Internal Linking Data').item.json.internal_linking_summary) }},
  "serp_summary": {{ JSON.stringify($('Extract SERP Data').item.json.serp_summary) }},
  "people_also_ask": {{ JSON.stringify($('Extract Reddit & PAA').item.json.all_paa_questions) }}
}
